entities.text: High Court Of Judicature At Allahabad
entities.label: COURT

sentences.text:
Applicant :- Smt Roli
Opposite Party :- State of U.P. and Another

Counsel for Applicant :- Rajendra Prasad Yadav
Counsel for Opposite Party :- G.A.
Hon'ble Anish Kumar Gupta,J.
1.
Heard Sri Rajendra Prasad Yadav, learned counsel for the applicant and Sri Brijesh Kumar Dwivedi, learned AGA for the State.

2. This application u/S 482 Cr.P.C. has been filed by the applicant seeking a direction upon the court below to decide Case No.970 of 2021 (Roli vs. Jamuna Prasad Gupta) under Sections 498A, 323,
504, 506, 406 IPC and Section 3/4 D.P. Act, Police Station-Khutahan, District-Jaunpur, pending in the court of ACJM-V, Jaunpur.

entities.text: Case No.970 of 2021 (Roli vs. Jamuna Prasad Gupta)
entities.label: PRECEDENT

sentences.text:
3. Learned counsel for the applicant submits that he has filed an application under Section 156 (3)
Cr.P.C. in the year 2021, however, vide order dated 16.8.2021, the same was directed to be converted as the complaint case.
Learned counsel for the applicant submits that her statement was recorded under Section 200 Cr.P.C. on 2.11.2021 and the statement of PW-1 Vindhya Devi was recorded on 6.4.2022.

However, the statement of other witness PW-2 has not yet been recorded and from the Smt Roli vs State Of U.P. And Another on 12 August, 2024 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/192286781/
1 order-sheet, it is apparent that various opportunities have been granted to the applicant herein to produce the witness

entities.text: Smt Roli vs State Of U.P. And Another
entities.label: PRECEDENT

sentences.text: , however, no such witness has yet been produced.

4. In the aforesaid facts and circumstances, it appears that the instant application has been filed prematurely by the applicant herein and she herself is on default by not producing the witness under Section 202 Cr.P.C. for which various opportunities have been granted by the trial court concerned and the instant application has been filed for expeditious disposal of the said complaint case.

5. Since the applicant herein herself is in default, therefore, no positive direction for expeditious disposal can be passed at this stage.
6. In view thereof, this application is dismissed at this stage.
